meta.purpose: Complete, verbatim harvest of every user-facing string, URL and asset reference from the legacy static site. This is the input to the session-2 seeders.

conventions.translatable: Objects keyed by locale code: {"es":..., "en":..., "ja":...}. A null value means the legacy site had no variant for that locale.
conventions.verbatim: Strings reproduce the rendered text content exactly, with HTML whitespace collapsed as a browser would collapse it. Spelling and grammar errors in the source are PRESERVED and listed under meta.source_defects.
conventions.legacy_inline_styles: The legacy markup carried inline font-size/font-weight overrides on many Japanese strings. These are presentation, not content. They are recorded per-string under `legacy_style` so session 5 can solve CJK sizing properly in CSS, and MUST NOT be seeded as content.
conventions.description_blocks:
Project descriptions were
-separated pseudo-lists. `description_legacy_html` is the verbatim source fragment; `description_blocks` is its mechanical decomposition into {lead, items} so session 2 can render Markdown deterministically.

source_defects.note: Verbatim harvest preserves these. Each needs a deliberate decision in session 2 — fix or keep. None have been silently corrected here.

markup_defects.issue: used as a paragraph break instead of
Single untranslated <span> — no per-locale variants exist in the legacy markup. Recorded as es-only with en/ja null.

content_to_rewrite.issue: Claims the site is built in vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. This rebuild makes that false. Session 2 must rewrite it in all three locales.

es: Hola! Soy Simón Paul Chasnovsky, para usted, programador. Mi área de conocimiento general es full-stack web-dev manejando PHP (Laravel) y bases de datos SQL (MySQL) en el back-end, y HTML, CSS (SASS, PostCSS, TailwindCSS) y JavaScript (VueJS) en el front-end. Esto implica conocimiento de GIT, y también me gusta trabajar con C++, OpenGL y Java, principalmente en lo que aplica al desarrollo de video-juegos y aplicaciones de escritorio y móbiles (esto es más bien un hobby). Me interesa mucho la tecnología y en especial la computación, por lo que también con los años terminé con experiencia en la Suite Creativa de Adobe (Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere, After-Effects, Illustrator, Audition), en las suites de oficina de Google y Microsoft (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint), y en hardware (planificación y construcción de computadoras de escritorio y servidores, manejo de redes y troubleshooting).
Si te agrada mi portafolios, no dudes en contactarme, seguramente sea una adición valiosa a tu equipo; y si querés saber más sobre mi, andá clickeando los links en esta página.
en: Hi! I'm Simon Paul Chasnovsky, for you, programmer. My general knowledge area is full-stack web development with PHP (Laravel) and SQL databases (MySQL) in the backend, and HTML, CSS (SASS, PostCSS, TailwindCSS), and JavaScript (VueJS) in the frontend. I'm familiar with usage of GIT, and I also enjoy working on C++, OpenGL and Java, mainly for desktop and mobile application development (this is more on the hobby side of things). I'm very interested in technology, specially computing, which has led me to adquire experience in software like Adobe's Creative Suit (Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere, After-Effects, Illustrator, Audition), and the desktop suite's by Google and Microsoft (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint). I also really enjoy working on hardware (planning, building, troubleshooting and maitaining computer and network systems).
If you like my portfolio, don't hesitate to contact me, I'd surely make a nice addition to your team; and if you want to know more about me, feel free to go around clicking the links in this page.
ja: こんにちは！私はサイモン・ポール・チャスノブスキです。あなたにとって、プログラマーです。私の一般的な知識領域は、フルスタックのWeb開発であり、バックエンドではPHP（Laravel）とSQLデータベース（MySQL）を、フロントエンドではHTML、CSS（SASS、PostCSS、TailwindCSS）、JavaScript（VueJS）を扱います。これにはGITの知識も含まれます。また、C++、OpenGL、およびJavaでの作業も好みますが、これは主にゲーム開発やデスクトップおよびモバイルアプリケーション開発に関連しています（これは趣味としての活動です）。私はテクノロジーに非常に興味があり、特にコンピューティングに関心があります。そのため、Adobe Creative Suite（Photoshop、Lightroom、Premiere、After-Effects、Illustrator、Audition）、GoogleおよびMicrosoft Officeスイート（Word、Excel、Access、PowerPoint）、およびハードウェア（デスクトップおよびサーバーの計画と構築、ネットワーク管理とトラブルシューティング）の経験もあります。
私のポートフォリオが気に入ったら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。あなたのチームに素敵な追加となることを確約します。もし私についてもっと知りたい場合は、このページのリンクをクリックして、自由にご覧ください。

hero_lines_note: These are NOT translations of one another. Three role labels in three languages, each paired with a DIFFERENT tech list. All three are visible simultaneously on the landing page, each with its own ES/EN/JA pill that switches the site language. Preserve that.

menu_items.note: The Japanese label uses HALFWIDTH katakana (U+FF98 U+FF9D U+FF79 U+FF84 U+FF9E U+FF72 U+FF9D), unlike every other Japanese string on the site, which uses fullwidth. Almost certainly unintentional; the fullwidth form is リンクトイン. Flag for Simón in session 2.

menu_items_note: The GitHub and LinkedIn rows are <div>s wired to window.open(..., '_blank') in js/menu.js — not anchors. In the rebuild they must be real <a> elements inside the <nav> list.

social_links.note: Legacy markup has a single untranslated RYM with no locale classes, so it renders identically in all three languages. Session 2 should decide whether to fill en/ja (e.g. ja: レートユアミュージック) or keep the acronym everywhere.

documents.note: Untranslated single <span> in the legacy markup. The label names the CV's language, not the UI language, so leaving it as the endonym is defensible.

documents_note: There is no Japanese CV. The CV dialog therefore offers two entries in all three locales.
technologies_note: Untranslated by design (§2.4). Names are reproduced exactly as they appear in the legacy tech chips — 'JS' not 'JavaScript', 'VueJS' not 'Vue'.

projects.title: PDA MPI

description_legacy_html.es:
Módulo de Pedidos Internos (MPI) de la plataforma de e-commerce de Proveedores de América (PDA), con el fin de permitir el comercio interno de empresas. Permite:

-Iniciar sesión con una cuenta de la plataforma
-Personalizar y eliminar la cuenta de empleado interno
-Crear, editar y eliminar pedidos internos con distintas variables
-Crear, editar y eliminar bids para cada pedido
-Aprobar, rechazar, o proponer cambios a los pedidos, si el usuario es proveedor o admin
description_legacy_html.en:
Internal Requests Module for Proveedores de America's e-commerce platform, that enables companies to post and execute internal commercial requests. It allows:

-Logging in with a pre-existing PDA enterprise employee account
-Customize or delete the internal employee account
-Create, edit and delete internal requests with different variables
-Create, edit or delete bids for each internal request
-Approve, reject or propose changes to requests, if the user is a provider or admin

アメリカのプロベドーレスのeコマースプラットフォーム用の内部リクエストモジュールで、企業が内部商業リクエストを投稿および実行できるようにします。これにより、以下が可能になります：

・既存のPDA企業従業員アカウントでログイン
・内部従業員アカウントをカスタマイズまたは削除
・さまざまな変数を使用して内部リクエストを作成、編集、および削除
・各内部リクエストに対する入札を作成、編集、または削除
・ユーザーがプロバイダーまたは管理者である場合、リクエストを承認、拒否、または変更を提案することができます

projects.title: RE;NOISE

description_legacy_html.es:
Webapp que permite al usuario crear su propio ruido ambiental de fondo a través de laconfiguración de varios sonidos individuales. Permite:

-Encender y apagar pistas de audio
-Pausar y reproducir audios encendidos
-Ajustar el volumen de audios individuales
-Cambiar pistas de audio
-Pausar, reproducir y cambiar el volumen maestro
-Cambiar el fondo de pantalla
description_legacy_html.en:
Pseudo-dynamic Vue3 webapp for the user to create their own ambient sound through the configuration of multiple audio tracks. It allows the user to:

-Turn on and off audio tracks
-Play and pause ambient sounds
-Individually adjust track volumes
-Change audio tracks
-Pause, play and change the overall volume through master controls
-Change the background image

・オーディオトラックのオンとオフを切り替える
・環境音を再生および一時停止する
・トラックの音量を個別に調整する
・オーディオトラックを変更する
・マスターコントロールを介して全体の音量を一時停止、再生、変更する
・背景画像を変更する
